_comment: Model registry. credential_env lists ENV VAR NAMES only; values come from .env. Copy this file and point EMPYREAN_MODELS_FILE at it to customise. Keys are what agent cards and run defaults reference. mind_multiplier is snapshotted into each run at creation (rules.cognition.mind_multipliers); editing it here never changes an existing run. options: temperature, param_style ('chat' | 'reasoning'), strict_schema (bool, OpenAI family), reasoning_effort (string sent as reasoning_effort, OpenAI family; 'none' = no thinking), usd_per_mtok ([input, cached_input, output] USD per million tokens: list-price provider_cost_usd from reported usage, OpenAI family), tool_choice ('tool' default | 'auto', anthropic), api_key_env (env var NAME of the key), overhead_tokens (provider-side input tokens beyond messages and schema; model.FIXED_OVERHEAD_TOKENS by default), max_budget_usd, max_turns, max_model_requests (accepted CLI re-prompts per decision, config.CLI_MAX_MODEL_REQUESTS) and max_thinking_tokens (MAX_THINKING_TOKENS for the subprocess, 0 = off, null = CLI default; config.CLI_MAX_THINKING_TOKENS) (claude_cli); assistant_only (bool): the ref serves the built-in assistant only (ModelInfo.assistant_only; hidden from GET /api/models unless ?include_assistant=1 and rejected for agent cards, run defaults, place_entity and update_model_assignment by ModelRegistry.validate_agent_key). ${VAR} placeholders in endpoint/deployment/api_version/region are resolved from the environment.

models.description: Fake model: a deterministic scripted survival policy. Free, instant, no network; the choice for trying the world out.
Replays per-agent decision scripts from request.metadata['fake_script'] (test double, hidden from pickers).
Returns invalid JSON / illegal actions on a schedule to test validation gates (test double, hidden from pickers).
Hardened Claude Code CLI subprocess (no tools, no settings, no session, --json-schema); uses the CLI's own login. The served model is recorded as response_model.

Same hardened Claude Code CLI route without --json-schema: the decision format is described in the prompt and the reply is extracted and validated by the format gate. About half the input tokens of the schema route (no StructuredOutput tool).

Built-in assistant (chat, author profiles): Claude Code CLI with the 'sonnet' alias, assistant-only. max_turns 2 / max_model_requests 3 let the CLI's structured-output verdict reach the model once against a warm cache.
Built-in assistant (narrator, summarizer profiles): Claude Code CLI with the 'haiku' alias, assistant-only.
Anthropic API, cheap model for short simulations (forced tool use carries the decision schema).

AWS Bedrock converse API using the boto3 default credential chain (env keys, profiles, roles, session tokens); region from this entry, AWS_REGION env overrides when set. Add AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY to credential_env to require static keys.
Microsoft AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI deployment (Azure OpenAI deployments only). ${VAR} placeholders are resolved from the environment by the registry loader.
GPT-6 Luna on the Azure AI OpenAI-compatible v1 endpoint (deploymentless), non-thinking (reasoning_effort none). Cost is list price x reported tokens (USD 0.10 / 0.01 cached / 0.50 per million).

DeepSeek V4 Flash on the Azure AI OpenAI-compatible v1 endpoint; needs a deployment named DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Azure serves it non-thinking. Cost is list price x reported tokens (USD 0.19 / 0.028 cached / 0.51 per million, global).
